+## #1939 - Review the guide after #1802
+
+**Chosen.** Review every PR merged after #1802 through upstream/main
+`cda3d589` and update the existing guide pages by job stage. Keep a
+per-PR audit on the issue, including a reason for each change that needs
+no additional guide text. Also close the explicitly requested earlier
+Trochoidal parallel-lane documentation gap from #1788.
+
+**Why.** The guide must describe shipped behavior and the limits that a
+user must satisfy. The old text omitted the shipped ALC400G, body
+electrodes, wider Bore clearing and aligned 3D operations. New refusal
+and post behavior needs a remedy and its control limitations beside it.
+
+**Dropped.** Do not document unmerged Sodick 4-axis or flushing parameters
+as supported. Issues #1497 and #1499 remain open. Do not add screenshots:
+the change needs factual reference text and the existing operation
+schematics suffice. Do not regroup the guide again; #1908 already did it.
+Do not stack on #1920 or #1921: they change different sections in the same
+files. State the overlaps so the second merge refreshes against main.
+
+**Validation choice.** Add focused guide-content pins in `site/tests/`,
+the existing home for guide tests. Assert supported workflows and reject
+the obsolete no-machine and rectangular-only descriptions. Build the
+site to check internal links. No Rust crate or NC output changes.
+
+**Cost to change later.** A later guide regrouping must move these tests'
+page paths with the content. A later Sodick implementation must replace
+the stated refusals only after its control meanings and output are
+verified. The next release cut must file the v0.23.0 review; this worker
+does not create a future-cut issue early.

+### Explain G-code
+
+Turn on **Explain G-code** in the post options to append plain-English
+comments to supported blocks. Tormach PathPilot milling, Fanuc, Haas,
+Mazak, Doosan DNM and Fanuc Lathe support this option. The comments do
+not change executable words or motion. Fanuc-family posts omit an
+explanation when it would exceed the block length budget. Explain is off
+by default; a post without explanation support refuses the option.
+
+### Stops between setups
+
+For a setup-change stop, Haas, Mazak, Doosan DNM, Sinumerik, Heidenhain,
+grblHAL and TinyG lift Z and name the next setup before the M0 or M1.
+Ordinary operation stops keep their existing behavior. Heidenhain uses
+the section's work clearance and refuses missing or unsafe clearance;
+it preserves a tip already above that height. Sinumerik refuses a missing
+machine retract. This does not establish a safe home position for every
+machine: inspect the retract and the setup before running it.
+

+### STEP curve subdivision refused
+
+**Means.** An edge or swept curve is discontinuous, produces non-finite
+points, or exceeds the bounded evaluation budget. The message names the
+edge and shell, or the swept face. CamCraft stops that import instead
+of spending unbounded time subdividing it.
+
+**Fix.** Repair or re-export the source geometry. A joined B-spline knot
+can be valid; an actual jump cannot be made safe by a coarse tolerance.
+
+### `model '<model>' was imported incomplete - closed shell ... meshes open: ...`
+
+**Means.** The model loaded for inspection, but a closed STEP shell has
+missing walls after meshing. The model page and import status name the
+hole. Every operation on the model is refused at the post because no
+gouge check against it can be trusted.
+
+**Fix.** Re-export the model or import a sound STL. A higher facet budget
+addresses coarse surfaces, not these missing walls. Tool-body and fixture
+imports still refuse such shells instead of loading them incomplete.
+

+"""Provenance: Guide coverage for CamCraft changes merged after PR #1802."""
+
+from pathlib import Path
+import re
+import unittest
+
+
+GUIDE = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] / "content/guide"
+
+
+def read_page(path):
+    return " ".join((GUIDE / path).read_text().lower().split())
+
+
+def section(path, heading):
+    source = (GUIDE / path).read_text()
+    parts = re.split(r"^## (.+)$", source, flags=re.M)
+    contents = dict(zip(parts[1::2], parts[2::2]))
+    return " ".join(contents[heading].lower().split())
+
+
+class Release022Guide(unittest.TestCase):
+    def test_shipped_sodick_machine_replaces_no_wire_machine_claim(self):
+        edm = read_page("operations/operations-edm.md")
+        machines = read_page("check-and-post/machines.md")
+        self.assertNotIn("no wire edm machine file ships", edm)
+        self.assertIn("alc400g", edm)
+        self.assertIn("alc400g", machines)
+        self.assertIn("condition", machines)
+
+    def test_body_electrode_workflow_replaces_rectangular_only_description(self):
+        edm = section("operations/operations-edm.md", "Sinker EDM")
+        self.assertNotIn("it is a rectangular, sharp-cornered block", edm)
+        self.assertIn("electrode_from_faces", edm)
+        self.assertIn("outline", edm)
+        self.assertIn("gap", edm)
+
+    def test_explain_gcode_names_supported_posts_and_unchanged_words(self):
+        posting = read_page("check-and-post/posting.md")
+        self.assertIn("explain g-code", posting)
+        self.assertIn("tormach", posting)
+        self.assertIn("fanuc", posting)
